progress_update.summary: We completed the SSE Router code review fixes and ran a full /spectre:clean pass across all 15 modified files. Clean pass removed AI-generated comment artifacts: section dividers, step-numbered task comments, stale doc comments referencing removed watch_service method, and over-documented pub method doc-comments.
